'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• F-C1.1 — Working Capital Improvement
  Owner: finance_director
  Trigger: wc.ccc.days > 5days
  Impact: High, CashRelease
  Expected: -3–-10 days
  Confidence: High
  · DETECT sustained CCC or cash-vs-plan deterioration for this entity
  · IDENTIFY the dominant working capital driver (DSO, DIO, or DPO) for this entity
  · TRIGGER the corresponding execution Action Code for this entity
  ⚠ Trigger only if liquidity deviation is structural, not seasonal
  ⚠ Do not trigger if deterioration is fully explained by growth-driven inventory build

• F-C1.2 — Collections Acceleration
  Owner: head_of_credit_and_collections
  Trigger: wc.dso.days > 7days
  Impact: High, CashRelease
  Expected: -2–-6 days
  Confidence: High
  · IDENTIFY customers driving DSO deterioration for this entity
  · PRIORITISE invoices by age and exposure within this entity
  · EXECUTE reminders, calls, and escalations for this entity
  ⚠ Exclude receivables flagged as disputed or legally blocked
  ⚠ Do not trigger if DSO increase is driven solely by approved term extensions

• S-I1.2 — Inventory Rightsizing
  Owner: inventory_manager
  Trigger: inv.dio.days > 40days
  Impact: High, CashRelease
  Expected: -10.0–-30.0 days
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify SKUs with structurally high DIO
  · Adjust safety stock and reorder parameters
  · Execute rebalancing or clearance actions
  ⚠ Trigger only if stockout rate remains below tolerance
  ⚠ Do not trigger if OTIF deterioration is observed

• F-C1.4 — Payables Optimisation
  Owner: head_of_accounts_payable
  Trigger: wc.dpo.days < -7days
  Impact: Medium, CashRelease
  Expected: 2–6 days
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY suppliers driving early payment behaviour for this entity
  · ASSESS contractual flexibility and risk for this entity
  · ADJUST payment runs or renegotiate terms for this entity
  ⚠ Trigger only if Supplier Risk Score remains within acceptable range
  ⚠ Do not trigger if early-payment discounts provide higher economic benefit'
